safety_contracts: Archive snapshot and full canonical portable intent identities are frozen before fresh graph-bound Start consent.
Canonical intent remains JSON text across JS/Rust; full float number spelling is not round-tripped.
One guarded reference-analysis attempt per retained archive; each target gets one independent full-canvas semantic analysis/fit.
Commit/save/export never refit; actual post-history state is compared to its frozen candidate.
No human-image acknowledgment. Machine summary authorization explicitly has reviewed:false and cannot satisfy reviewed portable-source extraction.
Known preparation skip requires exact no-effect proof and verified editor return. Uncertain writes/save/return/export are query-only.
Canonical semantic owned-field ledger, live history, scoped target project CAS, editor return, finite captured scheduler and managed-copy importer are reused.
Memory and requested missing-class bounds are preserved, including disabled requested classes; no dropped groups or proxy fallback.
required_local_acceptance: Reference analysis count exactly one, independently fitted multiple target images, no inference on commit/undo/reopen/export.
Archive source replacement, retained snapshot/reference tamper, byte/intent mismatch, oversize, nonregular/symlink leaf and invalid manifest.
Fresh Start disclosure and acknowledgment; saved-definition/recheck/edit/disconnect/dismissal invalidation.
Missing/disabled requested class, unsupported source/model, out-of-range offsets and low-memory explicit failures.
Same source aliases refused before analysis; finite captured file list rejects over-capacity before import.
Known target failure stop/skip with exact return proof; lost load/publication/history/save/return/export remains query-only.
Post-history revision, complete candidate verification, canonical undo/redo, scoped CAS, unrelated records unchanged, project reopen.
Real RGB8/RGB16/RAW full-resolution exports for configured JPEG/PNG8/TIFF16 profiles with no silent format substitution.
Reviewed modes and generic scalar/portrait/reference preset behaviour unchanged; machine assessment not shown as viewed image.
limitations: No local masks or mixed portrait/reference recipe
No new models or sky/lip/person-instance classifier
